title: quercus lanuginosa var. croatica
intro: Quercus lanuginosa var. croatica, commonly known as the Croatian oak, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the Quercus lanuginosa species. It is a deciduous tree native to Croatia, characterized by its unique foliage and bark. The health benefits of Quercus lanuginosa var. croatica include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its rich content of flavonoids and polyphenols. The bioactive constituents of Quercus lanuginosa var. croatica include flavonoids such as quercetin and kaempferol, as well as polyphenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
